evals.name: single-feature-commit
evals.prompt: I've added a new user authentication feature with JWT tokens. The changes are in src/auth/login.py, src/auth/token.py, and src/auth/utils.py. Please create a commit for these changes.
evals.expected_output: A single commit with the message 'feat(auth): add user authentication' containing all three files
expectations: Runs quality checks (lint, test) before committing
Groups changes logically
Displays quality check results (commands run and pass/fail status)
Presents commit content (message and file list) to user for review
Waits for user approval before creating commit
Creates a single commit with Conventional Commits format
Uses 'feat' type for new functionality
Includes all related files in one commit
Commit message is in English and one line
Verifies git status is clean after commit

evals.name: multiple-logical-changes
evals.prompt: I made several changes: (1) added authentication in src/auth/, (2) fixed a bug in src/api/endpoints.py, (3) added tests in tests/test_auth.py, and (4) updated docs in docs/api.md. Please commit these changes.
evals.expected_output: Multiple commits, each for a logically separate change: feat(auth), fix(api), test(auth), docs(api)
expectations: Runs quality checks before committing
Groups changes into logical commits
Displays quality check results (commands run and pass/fail status)
Presents all commit contents (message and file list) to user for review
Waits for user approval before creating commits
Creates separate commits for: feat, fix, test, docs
Each commit has correct Conventional Commits type
Commit messages are in English and one line each
Commits are in logical order (feat before test)
All changes are committed

expectations: Runs quality checks before committing
Separates bugfix and refactor into different commits
Displays quality check results (commands run and pass/fail status)
Presents both commit contents to user for review
Waits for user approval before creating commits
First commit uses 'fix' type for bug fix
Second commit uses 'refactor' type for refactoring
Does not mix unrelated changes in same commit
Commit messages are in English and one line each

Detects failing test
Fixes the linting error
Investigates and addresses the failing test
Re-runs quality checks after fixes
Displays quality check results showing all checks now pass
Presents commit content to user for review after fixes

Only creates commit after all checks pass
Does not skip quality checks with --no-verify
